newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Iraqi foreign minister pushes U.N. on aid delivery.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi foreign minister pushes U.N. on aid delivery.

text.p: Iraqi Foreign Minister Mohammed Saeed al-Sahaf met Wednesday with the president of the U.N. Security Council to offer Baghdad's ideas on speeding delivery of aid to the country under the oil-for-food deal.

"I discussed with the president of the council, rather in detail, some remarks we have regarding the procedures used by the sanctions committee in order to give permission on contracts of food and medicine to Iraq within the framework of implementing Resolution 986 (oil-for-food)," al-Sahaf said.
